CREATE TABLE races
(
    raceId    INTEGER
        primary key autoincrement,
    year      INTEGER default 0            not null,
    round     INTEGER default 0            not null,
    circuitId INTEGER default 0            not null,
    name      TEXT    default ''           not null,
    date      DATE    default '0000-00-00' not null,
    time      TEXT,
    url       TEXT unique,
    foreign key (year) references seasons(year),
    foreign key (circuitId) references circuits(circuitId)
)

import csv
with open('csv/results.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    speeds = []
    for row in reader:
        if row['raceId'] == '5':
            speed = row['fastestLapSpeed']
            if speed:
                speeds.append((float(speed), row['driverId'], row['fastestLapTime']))
    speeds.sort(reverse=True)
    print('Top 5 fastest lap speeds:')
    for s in speeds[:5]:
        print(s)
    print(f'\nMax fastestLapSpeed: {speeds[0][0]}')
